headline: Tyler stepped away. The door was still open.
dek: A composite story built from sourced paths. Tyler is invented. The steps come from real recruiting patterns, and nothing here promises a result.

chapters.title: A season off
chapters.what_was_happening: Tyler stepped away from wrestling for a season. His parents worry. They ask whether a gap in the sport closes the door. Sourced stories show wrestlers who stepped back and returned.
chapters.what_they_did: They start with grades, the part still fully in their hands. They read Eligibility: the 2 Hard Deadlines to see what has to be on track (offering: eligibility-2-hard-deadlines, $9).
chapters.how_it_helps: Knowing the two deadlines turns a vague worry into a checklist.
chapters.image_prompt: A parent's kitchen table with a laptop, a printed transcript and a mug of coffee, fictional adult hands holding a pen, soft morning light; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos or wordmarks

chapters.title: Back on the mat
chapters.what_was_happening: Tyler decides to return. He is still finding his level. His family does not know what coaches will think of the gap.
chapters.what_they_did: They keep a plain log of every coach contact so nothing gets lost while he rebuilds (offering: contact-log). It is coming soon.
chapters.how_it_helps: A log shows who replied and who is waiting. It does not change a coach's mind.
chapters.image_prompt: A fictional adult college-age male wrestler tying his shoes at the edge of an empty wrestling mat in a quiet gym at dawn, no readable signage; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos

chapters.title: Wrestling and grades in one email
chapters.what_was_happening: Division III coaches read both. A sourced pattern shows a D3 school pitching its academic path to an athlete with no D1 offers. Tyler's family decides to write about wrestling and academics together.
chapters.what_they_did: They use the First Contact Pack templates to write a short first note with one result and one academic line (offering: coach-emails). It is coming soon.
chapters.how_it_helps: A short note with the facts in it is easy to answer.
chapters.image_prompt: A fictional adult college-age man at a desk typing on a laptop, a wrestling singlet folded on a chair beside him; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos

chapters.title: Money at a school with no athletic scholarships
chapters.what_was_happening: Division III paid official visits open January 1 of junior year (D3 Bylaw 13.6.1.1.1). D3 offers no athletic scholarships. Aid there is academic and need-based.
chapters.what_they_did: The family starts learning how D3 aid works with the D3 Path: Academic Aid First (offering: d3-academic-aid-first). It is coming soon, not for sale yet.
chapters.how_it_helps: Knowing aid is academic and need-based keeps a family from hunting for a scholarship that does not exist there.
chapters.image_prompt: A printed college financial aid worksheet with a calculator and a pen on a wooden table, fictional adult hands, no readable school names; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos

chapters.title: Reading a visit with clear eyes
chapters.what_was_happening: Tyler visits a few Division III campuses. He asks about roster spots and the major he wants. His parents watch how the staff treats him and the other athletes.
chapters.what_they_did: They carry the Red Flags checklist and note what they see (offering: red-flags). It is coming soon.
chapters.how_it_helps: A checklist helps parents notice things in the moment. It is not a verdict on a program.
chapters.image_prompt: A fictional adult father and his college-age son walking across an empty college quad in early autumn, backs to camera, no signage; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos

chapters.title: A fit, not a trophy
chapters.what_was_happening: In this composite, Tyler picks a Division III program where he makes the lineup some weekends and not others. He studies and graduates. The ending is ordinary on purpose.
chapters.what_they_did: They compare the offers side by side before deciding (offering: offer-comparison). It is coming soon.
chapters.how_it_helps: Seeing aid, major and roster spot in one grid makes the choice calmer.
chapters.image_prompt: A fictional adult college-age wrestler in a hoodie sitting in a university library with a textbook open, late afternoon light; cinematic editorial photo, 16:9, no logos

closing: One path, made from several real ones. The ending is ordinary on purpose: most college athletes play, study and graduate.
